purpose: Run existing ALIPROMPT repository technical commands and retain their outputs as evidence.
limits: A command result is technical evidence only; it never grants G0-G7 acceptance, QA release approval, Product Owner outcome acceptance, human production approval, or next-sprint authority.
Use only after the Task Contract and canonical sprint envelope are valid.
A command failure, missing command, stale revision, or wrong environment is failed or blocked evidence, never a reason to weaken checks.
